label: The Family of Quadrilaterals
subgoals: Count parallel pairs: one for trapezoid, two for parallelogram
Demand four right angles for a rectangle
Demand four equal sides for a rhombus

label: The Hierarchy
subgoals: Nest every square inside rectangle and rhombus
Carry parallelogram properties down to all children

label: Drill: rhombus-or-trapezoid calls
subgoals: Call four equal sides without right angles a rhombus
Reject 9-and-5 opposite sides as a parallelogram
File the 9-and-5 shape as a trapezoid
